sources: https://www.camplife.com/998/reservation/step1 (CampLife booking API, park 998 'Canaan Resort': session, site records and one-night estimates for 2026-10-17, 2026-10-20, 2027-01-26, 2027-01-30, 2027-06-08, 2027-06-12; read 2026-10-21)

values.note: Operator's CampLife booking engine, one night before tax: every back-in and pull-through RV site $69 (October 2026, June 2027, weekday and Saturday alike) and $63 in January 2027; primitive tent sites $35. Full payment at booking.

fees.source: https://www.camplife.com/998/reservation/step1 (invoice estimates: Back-in and Pull Through $69 on 2026-10-17/20 and 2027-06-08/12, $63 on 2027-01-26/30; Tent $35; read 2026-10-21) + https://www.canaanresort.com/stay/camping ('Full payment is required at the time of booking')

hookups.source: https://www.canaanresort.com/stay/camping ('All sites have 30/50 AMP, Electric, Water & Sewer.', 'Water is disconnected from October to April.') + CampLife park record ('Water & Sewer is disconnected October-April'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 59 paved full-hookup RV sites plus 2-3 primitive tent sites (the resort page says 2, CampLife 3). Lengths 15-60 ft, about half drive-through; site 36 is listed at 85 ft. Sites 9, 11, 12 and 29 are 20 ft or less.

sites.source: https://www.canaanresort.com/general-uploads/Files/Camp-Site-Size-Type23-2.pdf (site, max size, back-in/drive-thru for sites 1-59) + https://www.canaanresort.com/stay/camping ('one of our 59 campsites or 2 primitive tent sites'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Comfort station with laundry and showers year-round; discharge (dump) station; camp store at the check-in station; playground. Fire ring and picnic table at each site.

facilities.source: https://www.canaanresort.com/stay/camping ('Comfort station w/laundry & shower facilities year-round', 'Discharge station for self-contained units', 'Complimentary WiFi', 'Camp Store located at Check-in Station'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Booked online through the resort's CampLife page ('Reserve Online') or at 304-866-4145, not on the WV State Parks booking site. Full payment at booking; deposit refundable on cancellation at least 7 days before arrival. Check-in 1 pm, check-out noon; 2 vehicles and 1 camper + 1 tent (or 2 tents) per site.

booking.source: https://www.canaanresort.com/stay/camping ('Easily reserve your campsite online today.' -> camplife.com/998, 'For more information call 304-866-4145', cancellation/deposit policy, check-in/out, site limits) + CampLife API, read 2026-10-21

summary: Run by the resort concessioner and booked on CampLife, not book.wvstateparks.com. Added fees $63-$69 (CampLife quotes, Jan / Oct-Jun), 30/50-amp full hookups (water/sewer off October-April), 59 sites 15-60 ft with pull-throughs, showers/laundry/dump/wifi/camp store, CampLife booking. Not stated: a maximum stay or a minimum stay; season left inherited (conflict below).
flags: Ownership/operator: the resort and its campground are run by a concessioner (canaanresort.com is '(c) 2026 Regency Hotel Management Company') and booked on CampLife at the resort's own prices, not through WV State Parks' booking site. Ownership 'state' is defensible (a WV state park), but the state:WV row does not fit: CampLife sells a single Saturday night (one-night quotes for Saturday 2027-06-12 and 2027-01-30), so the inherited 2-night weekend minimum is wrong here, and the 14-night max is not stated by the resort. An entry cannot store 'no minimum'; consider policy_ref 'none' for this entry.

Season conflict: wvstateparks.com says 'The campground is open spring through fall, weather permitting', but the resort's page runs the comfort station 'year-round', disconnects water 'from October to April', and CampLife sells RV sites for January 2027 nights ($63). Looks year-round with seasonal water; season not written.
Entry has no phone. The resort's camping page gives 304-866-4145 for the campground (resort 304-866-4121, toll-free 800-622-4121).
Price: base $69/night (state-park resort, so the US$50 private gate does not apply).
